_tier: Tier A: map IDs, widths, original_life and the three bosses from v83 Map.wz / Mob.wz. Tier C: region, map order and pool rules (spec #449 C3, ticket #465, progression step 8), the 900 s duration and every pacing value, which copy Sleepywood's keyframe numbers (rate, max_alive, hp, speed), bursts, elites, exp_mult and hard_cap exactly (Sleepywood carries no post_duration_slope). Only the pools differ, and there is no opening_ramp: level_scale takes its place. Keyframes from 300 s carry no pool because map 1 picks only keyframes with t < 300 (maps 2 and 3 use their own life lists).
name: Black Mountain
_bosses: Tier C: owner schedule (Scholar Ghost, Blue King Goblin, Nine-Tailed Fox; spec #449, #270's picks); hp_mult, dmg_mult and attack_dmg_mult are the first draft of game/tools/level_scale_draft.gd (--step=8 --stage=korean_folk_town), not tuned. 8 s per-attack cadence as every boss. Canonical attacks, timing, stats and elements stay in Mob.wz. All bosses and reward choices must finish to clear.
_maps: Tier C: owner map order and pool rules, spec #449. Each boss time is relative to map entry. Map 1 is a hand-written curve pool of its own roster (Moon Bunny; the three stray Dark Axe Stump L22 spawn points are not in it, v83 Lv22 filler in a Lv45 field). Map 2 uses its v83 life list (Hodori, Hogul; Hogul's timed spawn is an ordinary mob, not a boss). Map 3 uses its life list without the timed, boss-flagged Scholar Ghost 6090003 (mobTime 3600 s), which is map 1's boss instead. Blue King Goblin is one of three colours; Yellow and Green King Goblin stay unscheduled, so one King Goblin appears in the whole progression.

_level_scale: Tier C (#465, #449 first draft): pasted from level_scale_draft.gd --step=8 --stage=korean_folk_town, not tuned. exp_level(t) is Sleepywood's effective level E_sw at each keyframe time, and level(t) = E_sw(t) + 3 x (8 - 5), so every region levels the character at Sleepywood's pace and this step is nine effective levels harder. Without it the stage would run its canonical monsters at full strength from 0:00 for a Lv1 character. C13 (#475, tier C, calibrated on training seeds 1-4): level(t) = lerp(1, E_sw(t) + 2.25, min(1, t/600)): the stage starts at effective level 1 and reaches this step's level at 10:00, because a Lv1 character cannot take Lv12-and-up damage from the first second; 2.25 levels above Sleepywood here (0.75 per step to step 12, 0.25 per step after it: the first draft's +3 per step out-ran what a band's equipment adds).
_pools: Tier C weights (#465), map 1 only: Moon Bunny 4230300 (Lv45) is the map's only monster once the stray Lv22 Dark Axe Stump is dropped, so both keyframes below 300 s carry it alone.
